title: Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
short_desc: Manage Azure identities, storage, compute, networking and monitoring for the AZ-104 exam.
description: Prepare for the Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) exam. Lessons follow the five skill areas in the official study guide with admin tasks, Microsoft Learn links and scenario practice questions.
what_you_learn: Manage Microsoft Entra users, groups, RBAC and governance | Configure storage accounts, redundancy and access | Deploy and manage VMs, containers and App Service | Configure virtual networks, NSGs, peering and load balancing | Monitor resources and configure backup and recovery
requirements: Experience with Azure portal, PowerShell or CLI is recommended | AZ-900 knowledge or equivalent
